blocks.text: The following tables are lists of error codes you can encounter for ZSDK.
The following table is a list of error codes that you can see when configuring for ZSDK:

table: Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
Provide valid and correct parameters while starting the tunnel.
Your network is unavailable when attempting to start the tunnel.
Try again when the network is back online. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
There is an issue with the DNS while connecting the tunnel.
No action required. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
The ZSDK permission is not granted to the user.
Check the device in use for granted permissions.
ZSDK is not initialized when it is called upon during application creation.
Call the ZscalerSDK.init() method first before calling startTunnel or any other APIs in Android.
ZSDK is initialized, but there was an issue.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
The set proxy in WebView failed.
Ensure the Android WebView is updated with the latest version of the affected device.
The clear proxy in WebView failed.
Ensure the Android WebView is updated with the latest version of the affected device.
There is a pending startTunnel call.
Wait for the startTunnel call to finish and then try again.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
Proxy authorization is not supported in Automatic Configuration mode.
Data parsing failed at the server end.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
An invalid token was sent as a request to the server.
Provide a valid token when you send a request to the server.
The server encountered a bad request.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
An error was encountered when starting the tunnel.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
The tunnel is already in a running state.
Authentication failed due to a configuration error.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
Connection was terminated during upgrade to the Zero Trust tunnel. The existing Prelogin tunnel is invalid and stopped.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
The upgrade to the Zero Trust tunnel failed. The Prelogin tunnel remains active.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.

blocks.text: If you are using APIs, you can see the following API errors:

table: There was a failure to sign the certificate signing request (CSR).
The signing certificate is not retrievable.
Check and validate the signing certificate.
The signed certificate's custom extensions were not added.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
There is no registered Private Access (ZPA) service.
There are multiple, registered Private Access services.
There was a failure to revoke certification.
Unable to find token configuration for the tenant.
There was a failure to parse the JSON Web Key.
The customer key is not present.
There was a failure to parse the customer key.
Ensure the key type is supported.
Check the signature for validation errors.
Try again. If the problem persists, check the access token's fields.
The certificate_id is missing from the OAuth2 client.
The private key is missing from the OAuth2 client.
The JSON Web Token is unsupported.
Ensure the JSON Web Token is supported.
There was a failure to fetch the Hash-based Message Authentication Code (HMAC) secret from Private Access.
Check the HMAC secret from Private Access.
There was a failure to validate HMAC payload.
Some or all mandatory parameters are missing.
Ensure all mandatory parameters are provided.
The app's ZSDK ID does not exist.
Create a new app and publish it in order to use the ZSDK ID.
The app failed to fetch the HMAC secret from Private Access.
Check the HMAC secret from Private Access.
The public key is too short.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
ZSDK failed to retrieve the configuration.
Try again. If the problem persists, contact Zscaler Support.
The Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) violates security policies.
